title: Restriction augmentation into abelian hypercover totals
statement: For a simplicial object U over a pro-etale X-object W, define restriction of abelian sections at W to U_0, then include it into degree zero of the extended alternating section row [def-weil-pbc-proetale-abelian-hypercover-total]. Its composite with the first alternating differential is zero. The resulting single-degree row map and the natural map from the section complex at W to the hypercover total have degree-n component restriction followed by the (0,n) total inclusion.
